prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1239; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is currently receiving medical treatment.

Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly. If you have received any statements or other communications from our client, please let us know immediately.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the insured driver and vehicle involved in this incident, along with a copy of the declarations page for that policy.

Finally, we ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence related to this collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data, dash camera footage, claim notes, recorded statements, repair estimates, and any other documents or electronic records relating to the accident or the vehicles involved.
